column3: Upon The Willard & The Met Whole Loan becoming a specially serviced loan under the BMO 2025-C13 PSA, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer thereunder will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly with respect to such Whole Loan accruing at a rate that is anticipated to be equal to the greater of 0.25% per annum and the rate that would result in a special servicing fee of $5,000 for the related month.
